newsitem.title: USA: Advanta extends "standstill" with VISA, MasterCard.
newsitem.headline: Advanta extends "standstill" with VISA, MasterCard.

text.p: Advanta Corp extended a "standstill" agreement with credit card companies Visa and MasterCard in a dispute over an Advanta-issued credit card tied to the American Express Co rewards program, an Advanta spokeswoman said Tuesday.
The standstill agreement, which arises out of suits filed against Advanta by the two bankcard associations, has been extended through Feb. 28. It had been scheduled to expire Wednesday.
The suits arose out of the Spring House, Pa., bank's offer late last year to issue bankcards that earn points in the American Express rewards program.

Advanta has agreed with MasterCard to make no new offers, but it may fulfill applications that arose from its first solicitation. Details of the agreement with Visa cannot be disclosed, the spokeswoman said.
